correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of every perfect matching and distinct allowed edge pair for n=2..6 verifies D_n and all four edge-incidence orbits. Inclusion-exclusion gives D_m=2(m-1)(D_{m-1}+D_{m-2}); transitivity p=1/[2(n-1)]; conditioning on an edge gives c=2(n-1)D_{n-2}/D_n and exact gamma_2, gamma_3, gamma_4. The recurrence proves gamma_3,gamma_4>0, gamma_2 positive n=2,4 and negative n=3 or n>=5; asymptotics use known D_n count. At n=4 gamma_2=1/180, exactly confirmed.
